`@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 1.2.3 (Apache-2.0): `vision_bundle.js` and `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.*` from the npm package. `face.tflite`: BlazeFace short range, float16, from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range/float16/1/blaze_face_short_range.tflite. Used by presence.js, offline. The bundle has a usage log to Google that cannot be switched off: the page CSP and main.cjs block every network request of the kiosk page.
